PETITION FOR THE PLAIN RECORDING OF MORWENNA MORVAIN

To the lawful authority before whom petitions are laid,

I set down this request concerning Morwenna Morvain, not to raise
her above her station, nor to cast her beneath it, but that her name
may remain unwarped by invention.

Let the record state plainly that Morwenna Morvain is a minor figure
of the Ashen Era. Let it further state that she serves as a Gaoler.
These words are sufficient for the present petition. They give her
station without crowning her with honors she has not claimed, and
without fastening accusations to her that have not been brought
before this authority.

Let the record also state that Morwenna Morvain was born in 258 AS.
If the year is written, let it be written so. If the name is
entered, let it be entered whole. Let no hand shorten it, alter it,
or replace it with a convenient mark merely because the bearer is of
minor account. A small name may still be made crooked by careless
ink.

I ask also that no false likeness be attached to her. No canonical
physical traits or distinctive visual features are established for
Morwenna Morvain. Therefore, let no description be treated as
settled fact merely because it fills an empty margin. Do not give
her a scar, a color, a height, a deformity, a beauty, or any other
visible sign unless a proper record should one day establish it. An
empty space is not permission to furnish the truth.

Likewise, no canonical temperament or emotional disposition is
established for Morwenna Morvain. Let no account call her merciful,
cruel, fearful, joyous, cold, devout, faithless, gentle, or wrathful
as though such judgments were sealed. A Gaoler’s office may tempt
the tongue toward easy conclusions, but temptation is not testimony.

I am told that records endure longer than those who keep them. I do
not know whether this is wisdom or merely something repeated by
people who have not yet been forgotten. Still, I petition that the
account of Morwenna Morvain be kept to what is known: her name, her
place as a minor figure of the Ashen Era, her service as a Gaoler,
and her birth in 258 AS.

May the authority receiving this petition preserve the blank places

until truth, if truth comes, can fill them.

Submitted in good faith, by a petitioner who asks no honor for this
hand, only accuracy for that name.
